name: Voxels Grid to Mesh Conversion (Uncolored/Expanded)
definition: Converts a voxel grid into an expanded mesh representation where each occupied voxel is converted into a full cube with 8 vertices and 12 faces (6 sides, 2 triangles per side). This method does not share vertices between voxels.
summary: This method converts a voxel grid into a blocky, non-manifold mesh by treating each occupied voxel as an independent cube with unique vertices, avoiding the vertex sharing found in techniques like marching cubes.
